experiments.scope: The complete r64 two-block target. Before every request the organizer runs the packaged byte-exact mirror of the normative four-byte C emitter. Each trial runs one width-16 search attempt with the shipped table and recovery.
experiments.hypothesis: Every returned pair is distinct and its complete r64 digests agree in the low 16 bits. Null returns are valid; counts are program checks.
